subject: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build schedule & owners (SDK, streaming, tool-calls)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@medora.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@medora.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Integration priorities and draft MAP

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a first-pass ask so we can turn the discovery into a Mutual Action Plan. High-level priorities for Medora Systems: low-latency streaming for real-time triage, deterministic structured outputs for downstream workflows, and the ability to call our internal tools (patient lookup, billing flags) from generated outputs.

Would appreciate if you can propose a focused integration build plan with milestone owners and target dates so we can align with our procurement timeline. Our current goal is to be operational by the end of Q3 (target close 2026-09-30) but we can be flexible if there are technical constraints.

Attached: medora-discovery-notes.pdf (notes + sample payloads).

Thanks —
Elena Rossi
Product Lead, Medora Systems
elena@medora.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@medora.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Integration priorities and draft MAP

Elena —

Appreciate the clear priorities. I put together a short MAP draft that calls out milestones, proposed Redwood owners, dependencies, and a preliminary schedule. Please see the attached spreadsheet (20260825-MAP-draft.xlsx) and the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-Medora-MAP.

Top-level milestones (proposal):
- Milestone A (SDK integration): Dev Patel (engineering) — 2 weeks (dev sandbox + SDK install, sample app) — dependency: Medora sample payload and API keys.
- Milestone B (Streaming & low-latency paths): Dev Patel (engineering) — 3 weeks (streaming plumbing, batching profiles, latency SLO tests) — dependency: network/egress allowance and perf targets from Medora.
- Milestone C (Tool-calling integration): Markus Klein (sales/solutions liaison) & Dev Patel — 2 weeks (auth flow, tool schema, safety checks) — dependency: Medora tool API contract and test harness.
- Milestone D (Structured outputs / schema locking): Laura Bennett (CS) & Dev Patel — 2 weeks (output schema, validation harness, golden dataset) — dependency: example structured payloads and evaluation set from Medora.

Target close: 2026-09-30 (contingent on timely delivery of dependencies above).

Next steps:
1) Confirm Medora owners + any missing dependencies.
2) Technical workshop (90 min) to finalize API contract and streaming SLA — propose 2026-08-27 or 2026-08-28.
3) Sign off MAP and create JIRA runbook (we'll create the initial tickets tied to DEAL-8743).

I've CC'd Dev and Laura to validate schedule estimates and flag risks. Thanks — we want to keep momentum and avoid slipping the Q3 target.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0133

- We can provide the sample payloads and API keys by EOD 2026-08-26.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@medora.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Integration priorities and draft MAP — technical notes

Hi all — quick technical readout to surface risks and confirm estimates.

SDK integration (Milestone A) — estimated 2 dev-weeks if Medora provides: API keys, sample payloads, and a minimal sandbox account. We'll validate against our SDK v2.1 (node + python). Primary tasks: auth flow, sample call, KV cache validation.

Streaming (Milestone B) — moving this earlier is fine. To validate compliance we need:
- Explicit PII filter rules (list of fields + rejection policy)
- Perf targets (p99 latency) and target concurrency
- Network egress whitelist for test envs
Estimated effort: 2.5 weeks if we run streaming tests in parallel with SDK work; add 1 week if we must implement additional redaction hooks.

Tool-calling (Milestone C) — depends on a stable tool API contract from Tom. We'll need a test harness and a sandbox tool endpoint. Security gating: token exchange pattern (OAuth or signed JWT) + rate limits. Estimated effort: 1.5 weeks.

Structured outputs (Milestone D) — define final JSON schema and validation harness. We'll instrument a small regression suite (20 golden examples) to catch formatting drift. Estimated effort: 1 week.

Blocking items (please confirm):
- Medora provides sample payloads and sandbox creds by 2026-08-26.
- Network egress/peering window for streaming tests (internal procurement).
- Tool API contract + test harness from Tom by 2026-08-28.

I'll be prepared to run the technical workshop and can demo a streaming perf test if we have sample data.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
